text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: auth-proxy-eu unusual 401/5xx egress spike detected. Pager -> ryan_oncall. Auto-triage suggests log-forwarder involvement.
ryan_oncall: I'm on. Bringing SRE/security/infra into this thread. Any known deploys?
anita_sre: Seeing a 0.4% absolute increase in 401s for EU region over the last 12m, error bursts from proxy-eu-1. Top client IP range: 35.214.0.0/16. Some forwarded logs include raw Authorization headers.
josh_infra: There was an automated config change to log-forwarder at 2026-03-17T10:31 by infra-automation. Rolling back the forwarder is an option if we confirm exposure.
deploy-bot: rollback queued for service/log-forwarder v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0 (initiated by josh_infra).
megan_security: If Authorization headers are in forwarded logs we must assume short-term token exposure. Immediate mitigations: rotate proxy service account keys, expire session tokens, scrub/erase logs that contain tokens, and add temporary IP/WAF blocks for the suspicious source range.
ryan_oncall: Action list (short):
  1) rotate proxy svcacct key (josh_infra)
  2) set sessions TTL to 1h and invalidate recent tokens (anita_sre)
  3) scrub forwarder logs (josh_infra + anita_sre)
  4) customer comms draft + affected tenants list (chris_cs)
  5) legal + compliance notified (linda_legal)
Please ack and ETA.
chris_cs: Acknowledged. I'll draft an interim notification: "We detected possible header exposure in internal logs; we are rotating keys and will follow up within 2 hours." Need list of potentially affected tenants (EU proxy region).
linda_legal: Noted. Collect timeline, scope, and any PII checks. If tokens map to customer sessions, escalate to incident response committee.
josh_infra: Starting rotate + secret update now. Snippets:
```bash
# create new key for proxy svcacct
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create /tmp/proxy-new-key.json --iam-account=proxy-svc@redwood-infer.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# update k8s secret used by proxy
kubectl -n proxy set secret proxy-creds --from-file=key=/tmp/proxy-new-key.json
# deploy reload
kubectl -n proxy rollout restart deploy/proxy-deploy
```
anita_sre: Quick grep showing hits in the forwarder bucket: 
```
$ grep -R "Authorization: Bearer" /var/log/forwarder/ | head
forwarder/2026-03-17/part-0001.log: ... \"Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOi...\" ...
```
megan_security: Block source range 35.214.0.0/16 at the edge now and add WAF rule to strip Authorization header forwarding until scrub completed.
josh_infra: Applying edge block and WAF rule.
deploy-bot: firewall-rule apply succeeded for block-35-214 (applied by josh_infra).
ryan_oncall: :thumbsup: Good. Megan/anita — confirm whether tokens seen map to active sessions. If yes, we invalidate all sessions that used the proxy svcacct and rotate any downstream secrets.
megan_security: Forensics in progress. Initial scan shows token fragments only in a small subset of rotated logs; no evidence yet of external pulling beyond suspicious IPs. We'll confirm in 30m.
anita_sre: Rolling session TTL change: setting session TTL to 1h and forcing token refresh across EU proxies now.
chris_cs: Drafted customer message. Waiting on list of affected tenant IDs from SRE. Preparing CS/Support thread for inbound tickets.
linda_legal: Please preserve all logs and evidence copies for legal review before scrubbing. Maintain chain-of-custody notes.
ryan_oncall: Handing off command to anita_sre for incident lead. I'll be available for escalation but logging off in ~30m. Please add a postmortem label and link the forensic artifacts once ready.
anita_sre: Taking lead. Will update every 30m or sooner on scope and remediation status.
megan_security: Confirming next updates in ~20m. Adding temporary mitigation checklist to incident tracker. :lock:
chris_cs: I'll plan a customer update at T+2h with the interim statement and next steps.
ryan_oncall: Thanks all — keep this thread for live comms. If anything shows data exfil, escalate to legal and execs immediately.
